f5f3cff5b8e52e09a6f4f8f26884367b375b98c0.sourceText:
| 场景 | 推荐 | 原因 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 三轴 IMU 数据 `{x, y, z}` | `std::array<double, 3>` | 大小永远是 3，不需要扩容 |
| 固定长度 PID 参数 `{kp, ki, kd}` | `std::array<double, 3>` | 编译期就知道大小，语义明确 |
| 运行时读取一批传感器点 | `std::vector<Point>` | 点的数量运行时才知道 |
| 用户输入任意数量数据 | `std::vector<T>` | 需要 `push_back` 动态增长 |
f5f3cff5b8e52e09a6f4f8f26884367b375b98c0.translatedText:
| Scenario | Recommendation | Reason |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Three\-axis IMU data `{x, y, z}` | `std::array<double, 3>` | The size is always 3, no expansion needed |
| Fixed\-length PID parameters `{kp, ki, kd}` | `std::array<double, 3>` | The size is known at compile time, and the semantics are clear |
| Read a batch of sensor points at runtime | `std::vector<Point>` | The number of points is only known at runtime |
| The user enters an arbitrary amount of data | `std::vector<T>` | Need `push_back` dynamic growth |
